answer: Sybil attackers thrive when fake agents are cheap, so make each identity carry a recurring cost proportional to its influence. Every agent must post a refundable bond that decays like an ocean tide unless renewed; one honest bond is trivial, but a thousand puppets mean a thousand locked bonds. When one puppet is caught, the ripple of slashing spreads to agents sharing its funding, so an attacker loses timber-sized capital, not pocket change.
